lever_2.name: local gate
lever_2.status: enforced whenever the suite runs; advisory otherwise
lever_2.what: test_verdict_ritual.py pairs every done/verdict-shaped handoff with its closed executions and fails on a closure settled after baseline.as_of_ms with no verdict row

baseline.note: forward-only: gaps settled at or before as_of are recorded history, never re-litigated and never retro-filled; a row recorded after a closure does not rewrite that closure's verdict until it is re-settled
